title: Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR v2)
description: Custom robot chassis with optimized sensor placement; integrated ultrasonic and IMU sensors. PID straight-line control and obstacle avoidance firmware. Currently finalizing chassis design.

title: Air Quality Monitor (AQM)
description: Handheld environmental monitor on a Raspberry Pi Pico WH. Tracks PM1.0/PM2.5/PM10 (PMS5003) and temperature, humidity and pressure (BME280), and alerts via display colour changes and a buzzer when user-defined comfort thresholds are crossed.

title: Autonomous Robot
description: Self-navigating system that detects bus stops via computer vision, follows traffic signals, and avoids obstacles.

title: Autonomous Turtle Egg Collector
description: Autonomous rover for sea turtle egg conservation, built in a 3-day sprint. Designed mechanical-electrical interface in SolidWorks; integrated ultrasonic and IR line-following sensors.

title: Vision Mouse
description: Eye-tracking powered cursor control using facial landmark detection for hands-free interaction. Automatic calibration, no manual tuning required.

title: Weather Collector
description: IoT weather station collecting temperature, humidity, and atmospheric pressure data with real-time cloud integration and environmental monitoring.

title: RT-DETR Object Detector
description: Real-time detection system utilizing a Transformer-based architecture with model optimization for low-latency inference.

title: Particle Filter Robot Localization
description: Probabilistic positioning simulator using Monte Carlo methods for robot localization in mapped environments.

title: Rocket Launcher
description: High-precision mechanical Nerf-dart launcher designed and prototyped in under five hours. Achieved 83.7m launch distance with zero electronics.

title: SAD Light Diffuser
description: Wellness device combining light therapy with auditory and visual feedback to support mental health through seasonal transitions.

title: Gravity Based Water Pump
description: Zero-electricity water filtration prototype for power-outage prone communities. Filters harmful ions, salts, and bacteria using only gravity.

title: Drone Orientation Identifier
description: Custom PCB with LED arrays providing real-time aerial orientation assistance. Hardware-software integration for live status feedback.
